description: This file defines the DittoProtocolSub interface for managing subscriptions and acknowledgements in Ditto protocol channels, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, updating, and declaring acknowledgement labels for subscribers within an actor system.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSub
classes.description: Interface for managing Ditto protocol channel subscriptions and acknowledgements.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a subscriber to a collection of streaming types and topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the subscription list.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the streaming types and topics for an existing subscriber.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the twin events channel only.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels for a subscriber, ensuring global uniqueness.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement labels declared by a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoProtocolSub instance for an actor system context.
